Interface AgentView

All Known Implementing Classes:
EcsAgentAdapter, Individual, Symbiont
public interface AgentView
Interface representing the view of an agent for the AI. Allows decoupling ReasoningArchitecture from the heavy Individual class, enabling ECS integration via Adapter pattern.
